item.title: Defence Holdings commits £2m to defence fund founded by its own directors
item.summary: Defence Holdings has committed £2m as a cornerstone investor in a new UK defence technology fund founded by three of the company’s own directors. It marks a sharp change in direction after the group just recently announced its first revenue-generating contracts with the MOD.
